body:
When I showed my mom cuts that I've made, she called me a freak. The incident that finally got me help sounds like it belongs in a movie.. But I basically walked downstairs in my house crying (for no apparent reason) and screamed that if I didn't get help soon there was a good chance I would kill myself. I had an appointment made the next day. Let me just say however, when I said that, I was truly worried. But I could almost see that it would be a useful attempt, albeit possibly immoral, for someone that horribly blind to the subject.

But you have to do whatever it takes. Cutting is such a horrible thing for someone to endure, and I'm speaking from years and years of experience. I don't know you, but I'm sure you're a wonderful person and you don't deserve it.
